title: Bitter gourd: modeled ₹913/qtl left, Kottakkal → Pala
summary: January 2023: reported bitter gourd prices at Kottakkal and Pala imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹913 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 652 same-variety market pairs screened for bitter gourd in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Pala report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Kottakkal (Kerala) and Pala (Kerala) both reported bitter gourd prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kottakkal reported a median ₹3,150 per quintal. Pala reported a median ₹4,600 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,450/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,450 per quintal, and Pala was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 196 km by road
scenes.caption: 196 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹42/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹992 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹745 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Pala report, the rule selects 24 of 24 modeled shipping days. 24 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹913 per quintal (₹673 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Bitter gourd route from Kottakkal to Pala was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹91,300, or ₹67,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to bitter gourd
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹42/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Bitter gourd route from Kottakkal to Pala was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹91,300, or ₹67,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹16/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Bitter gourd route from Perumbavoor to Pampady was positive on 100% of matched days in December 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹107,300, or ₹78,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
